dict.string: Seal uses the microphone to record a voice message for an envelope. The recording is encrypted before it leaves this phone.
Seal turns what you say into words on this phone, so you can talk instead of typing. Your voice is not sent anywhere.
Seal saves a photo or video from an opened envelope to your Photos only when you tap Save.
Seal uses your photos to add a picture to an envelope. The picture is encrypted before it leaves this phone.
